method.clock: 24 fps on both ffprobe's native frame table and an independent FFmpeg framehash decode, with zero native origin.
method.controls: Apply the same local H.264 delivery to both members. Test the generated insertion against unchanged delivery, a genuine insertion of the same length at the same boundary, and a different genuine source as earlier copy. The genuine insert should be locatable as a physical change but provides no AI authorship evidence.
method.limits: Four smallest equal-cadence source triplets from a single publisher. No model, calibration or app change.
method.paired_check: Compare an earlier video with a longer submitted video. Fit one frame insertion and preserve all earlier frames in order. Use 96-square luma standardized per frame. Require at least 24 authentic frames on each side, a median retained difference no greater than .10, and a 90th percentile no greater than .22 on each side. Withhold if the candidate split is ambiguous by over 3 frames at the fixed profile-distance tolerance.
method.source_binding: Search the released triplet for the best global split within four frames of the paper's implied zero-based start. Compare aligned authentic prefix, generated segment and authentic suffix at every position in that range.
method.standalone: Compare app HSV shot boundaries with robust luma changes using fixed symmetric half-second windows, an absolute .10 standardized feature step and a 6 MAD margin. Report endpoints independently within three frames and retain ordinary-control boundary observations.
